# User-Supplied Stockfish WASM Binaries

To preserve strict GPLv3 / MIT license separation, Stockfish JS/WASM binaries are not bundled with WHATIF Engine.

To enable Stockfish in WHATIF Studio:

1. Obtain a GPLv3-compliant Stockfish WebAssembly build (e.g., `stockfish-19.js` and `stockfish-19.wasm`).
2. Copy both files into this folder (`public/vendor/`).
3. Start or refresh WHATIF Studio and click **Initialize Stockfish WASM** in the Engine tab or Import drawer.
